current_role: Former co-CEO of Renaissance Technologies; Republican megadonor
summary: Robert Mercer is a computer scientist who helped pioneer statistical machine translation at IBM before joining the hedge fund Renaissance Technologies in 1993, becoming co-CEO in 2009. With his daughter Rebekah he built a network of right-wing institutions: he was a major funder of Breitbart News, majority owner of Cambridge Analytica's parent SCL Group, and a top backer of Ted Cruz and then Donald Trump in 2016, helping place Steve Bannon and Kellyanne Conway in Trump's campaign. Under scrutiny he stepped down from Renaissance and sold his Breitbart stake to his daughters in November 2017, scaling back his giving before returning to back Trump in 2020 and 2024.

connections.name: Steve Bannon
connections.description: Mercer funded and co-owned Breitbart News, which Bannon chaired, and backed Cambridge Analytica, where Bannon was a vice president; the Mercers helped install Bannon in Trump's 2016 campaign. In November 2017 Mercer wrote that they did not always see eye to eye; Bannon left Breitbart in January 2018 and the family cut off support.
